login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: MoneyMap remembers you for 60 days — you won't need the password on this device again.

register.title: Sign up
register.subtitle: Accounts in any currency or cryptocurrency, one combined balance.
register.passwordHint: At least {{count}} characters. Checked against breach databases.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.subtitle: We'll send a link to set a new password. It works once and lasts an hour.
forgot.sent: If the address is registered, the email is already on its way. Check your inbox.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Changing it revokes every session on every device.
reset.success: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.
reset.noToken: The link is incomplete: it has no token.

verify.title: Email confirmation
verify.failed: The link is invalid or has expired.
verify.noToken: The link is incomplete: it has no token.

onboarding.title: {{name}}, one more step
onboarding.subtitle: Two settings the app cannot count without: which currency to total up in, and which calendar to date things by.
onboarding.currencyHint: Your combined balance across all accounts is shown in it
onboarding.timezoneHint: Affects the dates of recurring operations
onboarding.note: Both can be changed later in settings. The base currency is only a way to show the total: account currencies and the rates recorded in transactions do not depend on it.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.subtitle: Base currency — {{currency}}, time zone — {{timezone}}.
dashboard.emailNotVerified: Email is not confirmed. The link was sent to {{email}} — in development it is printed to the API log.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.text: Income, expenses and transfers between your own accounts.

netWorth.title: Combined balance
netWorth.text: Everything you hold, in one chosen currency.

reconciliation.title: Balance reconciliation
reconciliation.text: The gap between the real balance and the calculated one.

reports.title: Reports
reports.text: Spending by category, cash flow, net worth.

sessions.title: Active devices
sessions.subtitle: A session lasts 60 days and is extended as you use it. A revoked device loses access immediately, without waiting for the token to expire.
sessions.loadFailed: Could not load the device list.

settings.title: Settings
settings.timezoneHint: Affects the dates of recurring operations
settings.currencyNote: Changing the base currency only changes how the combined balance is displayed. Account currencies and the rates recorded in transactions are not recalculated.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Cash, cards, deposits and crypto wallets. The currency is set at creation and does not change afterwards.
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Add the first one — the ledger starts there.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.openingBalanceHint: What is on the account right now. May be negative — for a credit card.
